error_text:
ERROR: column "total" does not exist
LINE 39: SELECT total FROM (SELECT sum(amount) AS s FROM sales) t;
context: The outer query references a column the subquery never produced.
root_cause: The subquery aliases the column as `s`, not `total`.
fix: Reference the real alias (`SELECT s FROM ...`) or rename the alias to total.
title: ERROR: column "total" does not exist
